note: Event chains of the knowledge group, as data: for a main quantity (a family of measure-families.json) the ordered list of other quantities that follow it on a long story page, each a Eurostat table with its default slice, a semantic tag and the place it takes in the chain (English). Read by next_companion.rs (chain_companions) only; the main table's own companions (same topic, D8) are not here. A link stays on a page only when its fetched rows share places and years with the main table's; the order is the chain's order, so the first links that pass are the ones kept. unit: the unit-short-zh.tsv code the link's numbers print in (its short form is the page's unit word). kind: flow (a quantity over a period, drawn as bars) or stock (a level or a rate at a point in time, price kinds included, drawn as a line). measure_zh: the short Chinese name of what the link measures, partner and basis said, with no number in it (new page wording, owner-reviewed before it is printed). filter: the dimensions fixed to one code, each also in slice, so a link is one series (partner TOTAL, one price band); a dimension left with several codes in slice (the two renewable fuels, the fuels of the generation mix) is the link's own series. slice = the dimension codes the sample fetches (works/sample-1122/data/chain/fetch.sh for the energy chain); time and geo come from the page.

links.measure_zh: 从所有伙伴进口的天然气
links.position: Where the gas the grid leans on comes from: natural gas imports, so the share of renewables is read against the fuel it replaces.

links.measure_zh: 居民用电的含税价格（中等年用电量档）
links.position: What a household pays for electricity once gas and renewables meet in the grid: the price of a typical annual consumption band, taxes included.

links.measure_zh: 光伏和风电的装机容量
links.position: The capacity that carries the shift: installed solar photovoltaic and wind power.
What the grid actually generated, by fuel: where the installed capacity turns into electricity.

links.measure_zh: 公共电力和热力生产排放的温室气体
links.position: The end of the chain: greenhouse gas emissions of public electricity and heat production.

links.measure_zh: 劳动年龄人口的就业率
links.position: The other side of the same labour force: the employment rate of people aged 20-64.

links.measure_zh: 实际国内生产总值较上年的增速
links.position: What moves jobs: real GDP growth on the previous year.

links.measure_zh: 面临贫困或社会排斥风险的人口占比
links.position: Where it lands in households: the share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion.
